subject: Blind cross-provider falsification when the Claude lane becomes available

body.text: When Claude becomes usable again, do not give it Codex's conclusion for one of the finance/shell rendezvous objects. Give only the exact semantic refs, evidence refs, predicate to test, and executable baton. Claude independently derives the expected identity/unknown/evidence closure. Compare afterward: agreement becomes cross-provider review evidence; disagreement becomes TraceDivergence. Run the reverse pattern on a future Claude-origin result with Codex. Preserve provider weather: if Claude is exhausted, leave this review pending/cooling rather than treating capacity as semantic failure. This creates epistemic diversity by withholding conclusions, not by adding another agent role.
